title: Mathematics receipt
description: Extends frame-receipt-v1. Adds the two things a bare elaboration verdict does not carry: which toolchain produced it, and what the result actually depends on. Elaboration success is necessary and not sufficient.

toolchain.description: Checker and library revision. A receipt whose toolchain differs from the frozen one is stale in the same way a hash mismatch is stale.

axiom_audit.description: The axioms the checked result depends on, compared against the claim's allowlist. A new or metaprogrammed axiom is an escape hatch that a plain type-check will not surface, so this is required rather than advisory.

bounds.description: Required for the bounded tier: the stated finite domain actually searched.
